text:
CJ (Sales): hey team — Alandra Health is kicking off a 48h pilot tomorrow and asked if we can lift their generation quota for the EU-West pilot window, they're currently hitting admission control on hosted slots and the onboarding is blocked :grimacing:

Marta R. (Eng-Infra): flagged. what quota exactly do they want lifted? burst for 48h or a permanent bump? any committed $?

CJ (Sales): short term burst only, estimate ~1.2M tokens over 48h (~120k tokens/hour peak). No contract yet — it's a proof-of-value but they asked for low-friction pilot capacity.

alexa (Customer Success): they've been on our free trial credits; if we give a soft-exemption we should capture logs and set tight SLA dims. also want to avoid impacting other tenants in eu-west.

ops-bot: Admission control alert: region eu-west cluster saturation=89%, queue depth=378, 90p latency breach for short requests. Current spare slot headroom ~5% (prefill=off).

Kevin L. (Eng-SRE): sounds like full cluster pressure. options: 1) short-lived quota override + strict routing to a reserved pool (if we have Dedicated spare) 2) allow burst but route lower-priority requests to west2/west3 3) ask customer to use a quantized-6b variant for pilot to reduce token/sec.

Marta R. (Eng-Infra): we don't have a Dedicated spare in eu-west. west3 has capacity but cross-region egress adds latency and costs. I can temporarily open an admission override for a named tenant that will raise their rate cap by X tokens/s for 48h, but we need sign-off from eng-platform and finance for cost exposure.

CJ (Sales): they signed a PO intent email, can attach a pilot payment (covering GPU egress + marginal token cost). If ops can greenlight a gated override I'll confirm with legal/finance.

Kevin L. (Eng-SRE): If we do override, let's enforce these constraints: route pilot traffic through a dedicated route with bypass=false, set max_tokens_per_minute=180000, enable prefix caching for their common prompts, and add a slack webhook for errors. Example enable command for infra team:
```
# temp override (internal)
redwoodctl quota set --tenant alandra-health --region eu-west --tokens-per-minute 180000 --duration 48h --tag "pilot-exempt"
```

Marta R. (Eng-Infra): I can run that once finance confirms the PO. Also adding a soft-fallback model mapping: if latency>1.2s switch to 6b-quantized to protect tail latency.

alexa (Customer Success): I'll push finance to approve asap and update the customer expectations on degradations.

CJ (Sales): thanks — please go ahead after PO confirmation. If we can do a 24h rolling window first that's preferred by the customer. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: note: enabling override will increase cluster admission pressure; automatic fair-share smoothing may trigger for other tenants. Recommend pre-notify top-affected teams.

Kevin L. (Eng-SRE): tagging @marta for follow-up. once PO is in, Marta can run the command and I'll monitor SLOs. If we see >95% saturation we'll throttle the override automatically.

Marta R. (Eng-Infra): ack, will standby.

CJ (Sales): filing a ticket to legal/finance now and will upload PO here. will update thread when done.
